hub-get.definition: A bill of divorce; the document a husband delivers to his wife to effect a halakhic divorce.

hub-agunah.definition: A 'chained' woman — one who cannot remarry because her husband's death cannot be established or he refuses/ is unable to grant a get. Plural: agunot.

hub-keriah.definition: The ritual rending of one's garment as a sign of mourning.

hub-chillul.definition: Profanation, desecration — most often in the phrase chillul Hashem, 'profanation of the Name.'
hub-chillul.note: STRATUM-SHIFT CANDIDATE: nominal sense is post-biblical; the verbal root חָלַל (H2490, 'to profane / pierce') is Biblical Hebrew. Modeled here as a single stratum field pending Kymber's decision on shift modeling.

hub-divine-name-he.definition: Scribal abbreviation for the divine Name (the Tetragrammaton / Adonai), written with a geresh to avoid spelling the Name in full.

hub-divine-name-lahe.definition: Prefixed form ('to/for the LORD') of the scribal abbreviation for the divine Name, written with a geresh to avoid spelling the Name in full.
